fact: On 13-14 June 2024 the Ministry of Women, Family and Social Solidarity with UNFPA, UNICEF and WFP held a workshop validating the design and roadmap of the Social Registry for Guinea-Bissau, a registry still being developed under UNFPA's lead.
title: Workshop de Validação da Conceção e do Roteiro do Registo Social para a Guiné-Bissau
